newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras Q1 net rises to 691 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Telebras Q1 net rises to 691 mln reais.

text.p: Brazilian federal telecommunications giant Telebras issued the following statement on its preliminary consolidated results for the first quarter.
NOTE - All figures are in Brazilian reais and not adjusted for inflation. No comparative figures for holding net profit during 1996's first quarter was provided.
Share net is per lot of 1,000 shares. The company also reported a net worth per 1,000 shares of 88.82 reais versus 80.93 reais in the same period last year.

In the statement, Telebras said its first-quarter results included a non-recurring loss of 103.3 million reais at Telebras' long-distance subsidiary Embratel as a result of the disactivation of its telex plant late in the quarter.
The company did not provide further information on its 6.6 percent hike in consolidated first-quarter net earnings or other results from the period.
A Telebras spokesman said it plans to release its full quarterly results later tonight or Thursday.
